integrity: The proof gives an explicit local descent-complementing involution and exact telephone-number counting. An independent executable finite checker passed 345599 exact assertions on every involution of sizes 2 through 10. Finite enumeration is not an infinite proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for uniform involutions with n at least 3, local ordinary descents, and prescribed fixed-site indicators. Independence does not extend to arbitrary permutation information, higher-order relations among descents, or a fixed number of transpositions. Existing cycle-type/descent-set and joint fixed-count/descent enumerators retain a specialization-priority risk.
title: Local descent complementation and fixed-point dependence in uniform random involutions
